cover_headline: India Beat Sri Lanka and Uganda to Complete Commonwealth Kabaddi Double
facts: India won the men's final 54-20 over Sri Lanka and the women's final 35-15 over Uganda in Ahmedabad
The men's team finished unbeaten with eight wins from eight matches, scoring 380 points and conceding 193 across the tournament
Aditya Shinde scored a Super 10 with 10 raid points in the men's final, while Sakshi top-scored with nine raid points in the women's final

quote.text: With more and more tournaments being held, it's great for the people of Ahmedabad too, and we received so much support from them.
quote.speaker: Aditya Shinde

end.headline: India Beat Sri Lanka and Uganda to Complete Commonwealth Kabaddi Double
end.line: India won the men's final 54-20 over Sri Lanka and the women's final 35-15 over Uganda in Ahmedabad to claim both titles at the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship.
